title: Lock examples/: what CI applies is under the lockfile
objective: Put examples/** under INTEGRITY_PATHS so an edit, addition or removal of an example without a re-sign is drift, on the rule that anything the gate or CI applies is locked.
business_value: CI validates examples/gate-dossier.G00.json on every run and the drift walker reads two example files as shipped instances; today an edit to them carries no re-sign in the diff.
in_scope: tests: example edit / added file without re-sign is drift; coverage test counts examples/
acceptance_criteria: repo refuses an example edit without re-sign naming the file
repo refuses an added example file without re-sign
lockfile carries every file under examples/
suite green; compose green in both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design; reconciled by the next WP's branch.
